validity_findings.finding: derived/metrics.json and derived/decision.json were NOT emitted by the frozen process. The frozen module completed the entire primary transaction (35/35 offline controls, observation-0 census, 360 s separation, observation-1 re-fetch of all 1107 admitted pages, 10 self-pairs, 10 control probes) and then raised ValueError in parent_window() at 2026-10-17T15:18:18Z while entering the SECONDARY B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel, before writing the derived files. Verified: raw/PROGRESS.json has no finished_utc; the stderr traceback at /tmp/opencode/exp390_run2.log shows the exact ValueError (time data '2026-10-17T00:45:32.184Z' does not match format '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'); observation O2 in result.json matches. The derived files were produced by importing the byte-identical frozen module (stripped sha256 5d2509f691193c610a9797e4c473ee9425c010c1a4bd35f65b43e3aca672c573, re-verified by the auditor against prereg.md#10) and replaying its own pure summarize()/decide() over its own RAW rows; the four values the frozen process could not emit (M-WALL-S, M-PARTIAL, M-TIME-TRUNCATED-HOSTS, the GET ledger) are reconstructed from the frozen run's own checkpoints and itemised in run/derived/metrics.json#reconstruction_notes and result.json#validity_notes. Auditor independently recomputed every primary metric from run/raw/*.jsonl and all values match exactly. status=COMPLETE is justified: the primary measurement transaction completed and all primary RAW evidence was written by the frozen process before the crash; the crash is confined to a secondary channel that by frozen design (prereg.md#11 step 6) cannot change the primary label.

validity_findings.severity: disclosed limitation bounding the claim ceiling (not a falsification)
validity_findings.finding: The B-RETRO-LONG-DT channel is NOT ADMITTED by its own frozen gate, for two independent frozen-module defects, both verified by the auditor: (1) parent_window() parses the frozen parent provenance timestamps with strptime pattern %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ, but the bound parent provenance.json timeline_utc records scored_run_started=2026-10-17T00:45:32.184Z and scored_run_finished=2026-10-17T00:46:04.288Z with fractional seconds, so it raises ValueError (this is the crash); (2) even with a tolerant read, the frozen gate computes dt_h = (rec.t_start - p_end)/3600 where rec.t_start is a time.monotonic() reading and p_end is a POSIX epoch value, mixing two clocks; the auditor recomputed dt_h from raw/retro.jsonl and gets median -497831.608 h, outside the frozen [6 h, 30 d] admission band. Consequence: the days-to-weeks band stays undecided, exactly as the frozen design permits. The channel WAS executed in a separate clearly-labelled pass: 292 parent reference pages re-fetched, 0 byte changes, strata 31 deep / 261 shallow, max per-host change rate 0.00 (not negotiation-suspected); reported only as a non-decisional secondary observation (run/derived/retro_secondary.json, run/raw/retro.jsonl). By frozen design it cannot change the primary label.

validity_findings.finding: The certified level is computed on the frozen structural-text channel, which is blind to HTML attributes by construction (C-DETECT-ATTR-ONLY). The conservative byte channel finds 7 attribute/script-only changes (3 deep, 4 shallow) and its exact bounds are M-HAZARD-BYTE-UB95-DEEP=0.011264 and M-HAZARD-BYTE-UB95-SHALLOW=0.021609: the shallow byte bound EXCEEDS the 0.01 certified level, so the CERTIFY_BOTH_AT_0P01 label does not certify byte-identity at 1% for the shallow stratum. The producer discloses this (report.md section 3 and 6, interpretation 4); the product consequence is correctly scoped to the frozen channel. A product decision that requires byte-identity would need a guard even on this evidence.

The auditor re-evaluated every measurement-validity gate against the RAW evidence: V1 code identity PASS (stripped module sha256 = 5d2509f691193c610a9797e4c473ee9425c010c1a4bd35f65b43e3aca672c573, identical to prereg.md#10 block and result.json#M-CODE-SHA256-STRIPPED); V2 controls PASS (raw/controls.jsonl has exactly 35 rows, all pass=true; live positive 3/3 fired, live nulls 0/2, self-pairs 0/10); V3 seed liveness PASS (4/4 hop-0 seed rows HTTP 200, M-SEED-ERRORS={}); V5 separation PASS (requested 360 s >= 300; per-pair dt min 377.06 s >= 300; max 439.83 s <= 900; 0 pairs excluded below the floor, M-N-PAIR-EXCLUDED-BELOW-DT-MIN=0); V6 censoring PASS (0/1107 pages non-200 at observation 1; M-CENSOR-FRAC-* = 0); V7 page-gone separation PASS (M-DEAD-404-*=0, M-RATE-LIMITED-*=0, M-UNREACHABLE-*=0; the 6 obs0 non-200 rows are outside the admitted estimand and preserved in raw/census.jsonl); V8 envelope PASS (ledger 8+1123+1137=2268 <= 3200; wall 463.32 s <= 900 s, reconstructed from frozen checkpoints); V9 detector sensitivity PASS (offline injections both directions); V10 confounding tags correctly empty (M-HOSTS-WITH-BOTH-STRATA=4; max host concentration 0.332542 < 0.60; max version-pinned fraction 0.032070 < 0.80). No leakage found: GET-only, credential-free, deterministic target order, count-based frozen caps, timestamp-only DT floor exclusion; no outcome-dependent selection anywhere in the pair path.

baseline_findings.finding: B-SHALLOW-MATCHED-DT is a genuinely strong comparator: the hop<=2 stratum of the SAME live frame, SAME instrument, SAME UA, SAME measured per-pair separation (BFS caps are per host per stratum, so both strata come from the same sweeps). It removes host composition, vantage, transport and window as explanations for any deep-vs-shallow difference. M-HOST-TABLE is published (rust 220/43, pytest 219/98, readthedocs 28/140, pandas 219/140), all four hosts contribute >=25 paired pages to EACH stratum, M-HOSTS-WITH-BOTH-STRATA=4, max host concentration 0.332542 < HOST_CONC_WARN 0.60. There is no ceiling artifact: the deep stratum is 63.99% MOVING_ALIAS (release-mutable) content, version-pinned fraction 0.032070 << 0.80, so a zero in the deep stratum is measured, not true by construction.

C-LIVE-POS-SENSITIVITY: all 3 of 3 pre-registered volatile URLs (cloudflare cdn-cgi/trace, api.github.com/rate_limit, timeapi.io current zone) returned HTTP 200 at both observations and changed on the PRIMARY text channel (M-LIVE-POS-CHANGED=3, M-LIVE-POS-OK=3, verified in raw/control_probes.jsonl). Selection was pre-registered from a disclosed 6-URL pool probed at DESIGN (prereg.md#15 P4: 3 fired, 2 stable, 1 unreachable), not post-hoc. The zero-event result on the frame is therefore interpretable, which is the property the parent packet (EXP-FRONTIER-38940047535) could never demonstrate.

C-LIVE-NULL-STABILITY: 0 of 2 static anchors changed (example.com, www.iana.org/domains/reserved; both 200 at both observations; M-LIVE-NULL-CHANGED=0, M-LIVE-NULL-OK=2). C-SELFPAIR-DETERMINISM: 0 of 10 in-frame self-pairs changed on text OR byte, max intra-pair gap 0.006 s (M-SELFPAIR-CHANGED=0, M-SELFPAIR-BYTE-CHANGED=0, M-SELFPAIR-N=10, M-SELFPAIR-MAX-GAP-S=0.006). The in-frame family is the stronger null because it runs on multi-megabyte documentation pages inside the measured frame; it held, so the zero is not detector noise.

B-BYTE-CHANNEL is reported beside every text bound and catches exactly the 7 attribute/script-only changes the primary channel is blind to by construction; its bounds (deep 0.011264, shallow 0.021609) quantify the width of that blindness (see AUD-V7: shallow byte bound exceeds the 1% certified level). B-TRANSPORT-CHANNEL correctly stays a covariate and never an event: 359 of 1107 pairs (219 deep, 140 shallow) moved ETag/Last-Modified while canonical text was unchanged - the pre-2.0 cycle-8 instrument lesson replicated at scale on real HTML. Their cause is not identified (weak validators, per-request cache-busting tokens, or edge routing are candidate explanations) and is disclosed as unresolved by the producer; they must not be reused as evidence of staleness.

B-RETRO-LONG-DT was executed in a labelled secondary pass (292 parent reference pages re-fetched; 0 byte changes; not negotiation-suspected) but is NOT ADMITTED because of the two frozen defects verified in AUD-V2 (fractional-second strptime crash; monotonic-vs-epoch clock mixing yielding dt_h ~ -497831.608 h). By frozen design it cannot change the primary label. The true elapsed separation of that pass is order 14-15 h (parent window end 2026-10-17T00:46:04Z; retro pass executed 2026-10-17 ~15:19Z), which lies inside the [6 h, 30 d] band, so the observational content (0/292 byte changes over ~14.5 h on a shallow-biased, readthedocs-heavy reference set) is real but formally undecided. The days-to-weeks band remains open and bounds the claim ceiling.

claim_ceiling: Maximum justified claim ceiling: a session-scale per-page invalidation upper bound for a DECLARED page class, at the MEASURED separation only. Concretely: for credential-free GET-only server-rendered documentation pages on four hosts (doc.rust-lang.org, docs.pytest.org, docs.readthedocs.io, pandas.pydata.org) reached by same-host <a> navigation, from one egress vantage, on the frozen structural-text channel, the exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on per-page invalidation hazard over a median 407.97 s (min 377.06 s, max 439.83 s) window is 0.004357 deep (n=686) and 0.007090 shallow (n=421), so both strata certify the coarsest grid level 0.01 (CERTIFY_BOTH_AT_0P01, no narrowing tags). The byte channel bounds the primary channel's attribute blindness at 0.011264 deep / 0.021609 shallow (shallow exceeds 0.01, so the certification is text-channel only). Deep-stratum concentration is not detected and is bounded at M-CONCENTRATION-MDC-RATE=0.011662 (~1.17%), which is a bound, not an absence of concentration. The days-to-weeks band is undecided (B-RETRO-LONG-DT executed but not admitted; AUD-V2). C-WEB-DYNAMICS stays HYPOTHESIS per spec.json#claim_ceiling_rules CC-A..CC-D; no EXPERIMENTAL or PRODUCT_CORE promotion, no shipped freshness mechanism, no tolerance choice (1%/2%/5% is a Product decision), and no extrapolation to JavaScript-rendered content, authenticated pages, other vantages, or longer reuse lags. The producer's claimed ceiling does not exceed this and the auditor does not narrow it further.
